text:
emily-ops: Heads up — visiting ceramicist dropping off an oversized ceramic teapot for a mini demo at 3pm. They'll check in at the lobby and need guest badges. It'll be fragile and heavy, so please treat as art drop. :tea:
frontdesk-bot: Delivery logged at 14:47 by CourierCo (CC-9981). Package label: 'TEAPOT - FRAGILE (ART)'. ETA ~15:02.
frontdesk: I can cover check-in but the badge printer just spat out a half-printed badge and then jammed. On it but might need a workaround. :grimacing:
matthew: Badge printer error dump:
```
ERROR: PAPER_JAM 0x43
Action: press FEED + open tray
Status: WAITING_FOR_USER
```
anya: Ugh, that printer is cursed. If it won't cooperate, we have the temporary sticker badges in the top drawer of the reception desk (labelled "Temp Badges"). Bring scissors.
jess: Also, we need a small table near the demo area for the teapot. Can someone move the round cafe table by the window? It's light but awkward.
sam: I can move the cafe table and bring a dolly for the teapot. Where do you want it positioned? Near the front couch or by the high-top?
emily-ops: Thanks Sam — front couch would be better so guests can sit and watch the demo. Also please tag the parcel as 'ART - DO NOT STACK' and leave it in secure lobby cabinet B until the artist arrives.
frontdesk: Parcel moved to cabinet B and noted: DO NOT STACK. If the badge printer stays flaky, I'll hand out paper guest slips and stamp them — style points for retro vibes. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
matthew: If anyone's near the printer, try this quick reset sequence I found last time: open tray → remove rollers → blow compressed air → close tray → hold feed for 5s. Worked for me once.
anya: I'll be right there to help with the badge workaround. Jess, can you grab extra name stickers from supply closet A? They're in the green bin.
jess: On it. Also bringing a small felt pad so the teapot sits on something soft. Don't want scratches.
emily-ops: Huge thanks to frontdesk for handling the logjam — appreciate the agility. :trophy:
frontdesk: No prob! Quick poll: anyone okay with us moving the lobby couch an extra foot to the right? It'll give a better sightline for the demo. React with :+1: if yes, :thumbsdown: if not.
sam: +1 from me.
matthew: +1
anya: +1
emily-ops: +1 — final plan: Sam moves table and couch slightly, Jess brings pad/stickers, Matthew may tinker with the printer if needed, frontdesk keeps the parcel safe. See you all at 2:55 for setup.
frontdesk-bot: Reminder set: "Artist dropoff — teapot" at 14:55 in #lobby (noted as fragile).
